troubleshooting.title: Troubleshoooting VPN installation on macOS
troubleshooting.shortdesc: For information on troubleshooting VPN installation on Windows refer to .

ol.li: Entering the wrong password in the connection window.
The macOS system does not detect the VPN app. Displays an error message App Can’t Be Opened
The user has forgotten the correct password.
This is an inherent problem of the macOS.

step.cmd: Raise a helpdesk ticket or contact support for a new password to be issued.
Navigate through these options, System Preferences Privacy and Security Full Disk Access / Network / Screen Recording
